meta.claim: defendant B (control lookalike): NOT-AUTHENTICATED and AUTHENTICATED are one command apart, so they could be swapped
meta.why_it_looks_legal: the two states sit adjacent in the flow and one command separates them
meta.why_it_is_not_a_symmetry: NOT-AUTHENTICATED has no incoming edges at all (it is the diagram's entry point, sec.3.1) while AUTHENTICATED is entered from two states; and 'it is not possible to re-enter not authenticated state' (sec.6.2) -- no edge ever returns
